LABEL: central anterior body of uterus
Definition: The region of the body of uterus that is located along the midline on the anterior aspect of the uterine corpus, above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes.

LABEL: central anterior fundus of uterus
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the medial anterior region of the superior dome-shaped portion of the uterus, positioned ventral to the midline of the uterine fundus.

LABEL: central anterior lower uterine segment
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the medial anterior region of the lower uterine segment, the narrowing transitional area between the uterine body and cervix that becomes more prominent during late pregnancy.

LABEL: central posterior body of uterus
Definition: The region of the body of uterus that is located along the midline on the posterior aspect of the uterine corpus, above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes.

LABEL: central posterior fundus of uterus
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the medial posterior region of the superior dome-shaped portion of the uterus, positioned dorsal to the midline of the uterine fundus.

LABEL: central posterior lower uterine segment
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the medial posterior region of the lower uterine segment, the narrowing transitional area between the uterine body and cervix that becomes more prominent during late pregnancy.

LABEL: connective tissue of the uterine serosa
Definition: A portion of connective tissue that is part of a serosa of uterus. This connective tissue layer underlies the mesothelium and forms the structural component of the perimetrium.

LABEL: ectocervical stroma
Definition: A connective tissue stroma that is part of the ectocervix, underlying the ectocervical epithelium and composed primarily of collagen and elastin fibers.

LABEL: endocervical stroma
Definition: A layer of connective tissue that forms the supportive framework of the endocervix, underlying the endocervical epithelium.

LABEL: inferior uterine vein
Definition: A vein that drains blood from the lower portion of the uterus, typically arising from the uterine venous plexus and draining into the internal iliac vein.

LABEL: inner uterine myometrium
Definition: An organ part of the myometrium that constitutes the inner one-third thickness of the uterine muscular wall, characterized by circularly oriented smooth muscle fibers and also termed the junctional or sub-endometrial layer.

LABEL: left anterior body of uterus
Definition: The region of the body of uterus that is located on the left side of the anterior aspect of the uterine corpus, above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes.

LABEL: left anterior fundus of uterus
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the left lateral anterior region of the superior dome-shaped portion of the uterus, on the ventral aspect of the left side of the uterine fundus.

LABEL: left anterior lower uterine segment
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the left lateral anterior region of the lower uterine segment, the narrowing transitional area between the uterine body and cervix on the ventral left side.

LABEL: left posterior body of uterus
Definition: The region of the body of uterus that is located on the left side of the posterior aspect of the uterine corpus, above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes.

LABEL: left posterior fundus of uterus
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the left lateral posterior region of the superior dome-shaped portion of the uterus, on the dorsal aspect of the left side of the uterine fundus.

LABEL: left posterior lower uterine segment
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the left lateral posterior region of the lower uterine segment, the narrowing transitional area between the uterine body and cervix on the dorsal left side.

LABEL: lower uterine segment
Definition: A zone of the uterus that forms the inferior portion of the uterine body, located between the anatomic internal os and the uterine fundus, which becomes particularly distinct during pregnancy and labor.

LABEL: mesothelium of the uterine serosa
Definition: A mesothelium that is part of a serosa of uterus. The mesothelium forms the simple squamous epithelial layer that covers the outer surface of the uterine serosa, also known as the perimetrium.

LABEL: outer uterine myometrium
Definition: An organ part of the myometrium that constitutes the thick outer layer of the uterine muscular wall, characterized by longitudinally oriented smooth muscle fibers and serving as the major contractile tissue during parturition and abortion.

LABEL: right anterior body of uterus
Definition: The region of the body of uterus that is located on the right side of the anterior aspect of the uterine corpus, above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes.

LABEL: right anterior fundus of uterus
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the right lateral anterior region of the superior dome-shaped portion of the uterus, on the ventral aspect of the right side of the uterine fundus.

LABEL: right anterior lower uterine segment
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the right lateral anterior region of the lower uterine segment, the narrowing transitional area between the uterine body and cervix on the ventral right side.

LABEL: right posterior body of uterus
Definition: The region of the body of uterus that is located on the right side of the posterior aspect of the uterine corpus, above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes.

LABEL: right posterior fundus of uterus
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the right lateral posterior region of the superior dome-shaped portion of the uterus, on the dorsal aspect of the right side of the uterine fundus.

LABEL: right posterior lower uterine segment
Definition: A zone of organ that is located in the right lateral posterior region of the lower uterine segment, the narrowing transitional area between the uterine body and cervix on the dorsal right side.

LABEL: superior uterine vein
Definition: A vein that drains blood from the upper portion of the uterus, typically arising from the uterine venous plexus near the uterine fundus and draining into the internal iliac vein or ovarian vein.
